slides.title: Cohort Studio
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · Unknown checksum verification is counted as a pass
slides.fix: Use a three-state check: verified True, mismatch False, and unavailable/unknown.
slides.notes: Removed sources.csv from an invented test fixture. clinical.tsv had verified=null, but the frozen-checksum check returned pass and claimed every raw file matched sources.csv. The overall verdict was Blocked because the synthetic cohort was small; the false checksum pass is independently wrong even when another check blocks release.

slides.title: 2 · Request text is inserted into generated Python source
slides.fix: Serialize request text as a Python string literal with repr or a JSON value, rather than interpolating it into source delimiters.
slides.notes: A normal generated reproduction script parsed successfully. A request containing triple quotes produced invalid Python; a second harmless delimiter example placed a review_marker assignment in the generated program AST. These generated examples were parsed only and never executed.

slides.title: 3 · Automatic fixes are enabled by default in the API
slides.fix: Separate draft, preview and accepted execution states.
slides.notes: Calling build_cohort with its default fix=True changed a synthetic clinical join from patient_id to sample_id, removed the observed inflation, and retained the original run and an explanatory fix log. Explicit fix=False preserved the requested operation. The correction is documented and useful; the recommendation is to distinguish automatic preview from a human-approved change.

slides.title: 4 · Blocked outputs are exported beside ordinary cohorts
slides.fix: Bundle a manifest binding files to verdict, limitations, review state and hashes.
slides.notes: The actual write_all function exported cohort_samples.csv for a Blocked synthetic join-inflation example. verdict.json was also present and retained Blocked. Diagnostic exports are useful; the concern is preserving the restriction when a CSV is separated from its accompanying evidence.

slides.title: 5 · Automatic drafting can use a hosted service by default
slides.fix: Give a first-use routing notice or explicit opt-in.
slides.notes: Mocked own/hosted providers showed that ai=off called neither route; ai=auto tried own configuration and then the hosted route. No network request occurred. This verifies routing behavior and the local-only control; it does not establish what a first-time user understands from the interface.

slides.title: 6 · Reconstruction warns about changed inputs but continues
slides.fix: Make strict reconstruction fail on hash mismatch by default; offer an explicitly named exploratory mode that records new hashes and changed counts.
slides.notes: The normal generated script exited successfully and recreated eight synthetic samples. After one row was removed from sample_manifest.csv, the same script printed a hash warning, still exited 0 and wrote a seven-sample output. The warning and expected count are visible, so this is an explicitly permissive policy rather than hidden verification. It cannot guarantee exact reconstruction of the original frozen cohort.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: 299 submitted tests passed, zero skipped. Thirteen local browser smoke checks passed with invented data and AI off. Mobile labels still need layout review; no hosted or full accessibility verification.
